title: Clarifi's visual world
question: Your steer names the category standard: Revolut / Wise. That is already the recorded brand commitment and what ships on beta today. Lock it to confirm and keep building on the current design, or re-roll safer for conventional fintech alternates against those two.

options.label: Revolut / Wise canon (what ships today)
options.lineage: modern consumer fintech, executed at Revolut and Wise craft level
options.thesis: One headline figure, pill navigation, soft group cards, a clean lines list, light and dark by system, one teal-mint accent, Figtree.
options.viewport: Month pills and status chip, the headline figure for this month, Income / Spend / Put away, Spend and Put away group cards with stacked bars, Over time bars, triage one line at a time, lines list beneath.
options.risk: Recognisably the category by design; distinction has to come from precision and from the share-rule mechanism, not from the look.
